labels: enhancement

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see implemented.

## Problem/Use Case
What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it address?
- Is this for a specific job application scenario?
- Does it improve reliability, speed, or user experience?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you'd like this feature to work. Include:
- UI/UX changes (if applicable)
- Backend logic changes
- New configuration options
- API changes

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Implementation Ideas
If you have ideas on how to implement this, share them here:
- Files that might need changes
- New dependencies (if any)
- Breaking changes to consider

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions to avoid duplicates
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's goals (LinkedIn Easy Apply automation)
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to implementing this feature (optional)
